description:
Short movies celebrating the Fate/Grand Order 9th Anniversary.

Let's explore the world together! We are explorers!

The Earth may have been bleached white...
But let's go and seek out the world's beautiful scenery as it may have existed, together as Master and Servant!

To all our fans enjoying FGO, with our utmost gratitude.

(Source: Aniplex USA)

This entry includes:
1) nippon memoir (Dir. Rio Shimizu, Studio Rouseact)
2) Food ＆ Adventure (Dir. Xin Wang, Studio GARDEN)
3) WANTED！(Dir. Hiroto Nagata, Studio Shaft)
